title_or_table: Housing Vacancies and Homeownership (CPS/HVS), Annual Statistics: 2025, Table 17. Homeownership Rates for the United States, by Age of Householder and by Family Status: 1982 to 2025 (age rows only)
universe_or_base: Households, by the age of the householder; the homeownership rate is owner households over all households in the group
vintage: Table dated March 24, 2026 in its source note
qualification: Survey estimates. The 2025 annual figure leaves out October 2025, when a lapse in federal funding stopped data collection. Rows marked revised_1990_census (1993) and revised_2000_census (2002) are second readings of the same year on newer population controls; pandemic changes to data collection affect 2020

series_variant.description: empty, or the revised reading of 1993 or 2002

grouping.description: total, detailed age groups, or summary age groups (the table's wider rows)

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, Current Population Survey/Housing Vacancy Survey, Annual Statistics 2025, Table 17, homeownership rate by age of householder, 1982 to 2025, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Survey estimates; the 2025 average leaves out October, when no data were collected.
